description: USE THIS for "where can I get water", "is there a spring, creek, lake or waterfall near", "hot springs near" or "where do I fill up" at a latitude and longitude in Montana's Custer Gallatin, Beaverhead-Deerlodge and Lolo National Forests or any Oregon National Forest. Returns up to 25 water records within a straight-line radius (up to 50 miles), nearest first: springs, hot springs, waterfalls, lakes, reservoirs, rivers, creeks and Forest Service fill points, each with its kind, straight-line miles, what the record says about drinking in plain words (it never calls water drinkable: always filter or boil), how access is recorded (a road or trail record, not a condition), elevation, season, any posted advisory, the source links with the record date, and what the record does not hold. A point outside that area answers with an empty list and says so; it never guesses. The forest office has the final word.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (negative in the US).

types.description: Keep only these kinds of water.

name: water_near
title: Water near a point (Montana and Oregon national forests)
